messages:
maria: Heads-up: pen-test next Mon. Need retest acceptance criteria, RBAC pattern for assessors, KMS logging confirmation, and evidence handoff owner.

sam: Contractually 72h for P1. I'll update SLA to require exploit repro steps + patch plan within 24h and notification via email+slack.

eva: For RBAC: ephemeral STS only, scoped to a per-engagement S3 prefix and CloudTrail read. No long-lived roles. We'll produce a presigned bundle and a sha256 manifest.

jack: Ops note: KMS events (Decrypt/GenerateDataKey) are in CloudTrail. Ops, confirm forwarding and retention for those events.

ops-bot: Auto: CloudTrail -> SIEM index "security_audit" includes KMS events. Retention = 90d hot / 365d cold. Raise INF ticket to extend.

maria: Proposed retest acceptance: fix merged & deployed to canary; smoke tests pass; no repro in logs for 48h; KMS CloudTrail entries show expected usage only; vendor provides written verification. Jack to certify, Sam fallback.

eva: Playbook snippet I'll add: presign bundle, publish bundle.sha256, GPG-sign manifest, create/revoke KMS grant.

```bash
aws s3 presign s3://pt-evidence/${ENG}/bundle.tar.gz --expires-in 86400
sha256sum bundle.tar.gz > bundle.sha256
gpg --detach-sign -u ops@redwood.com bundle.sha256
aws kms revoke-grant --key-id alias/pt-key --grant-id "$GRANT_ID"
```

sam: Also require correlation IDs in vendor repro so we can map to CloudTrail/KMS events. Add smoke test script to triage card.

jack: I'll create the triage board template and invite for a dry-run Fri 09:00 UTC. Will include checkboxes: repro, PR, deploy link, logs, KMS event ids, sha256 manifest.

maria: Thanks. Action items: sam=contract, eva=evidence+signing, jack=triage+verify, ops=confirm SIEM forwarding. We'll iterate in this thread.
